expected_behavior: Identifies restaurants open at 8 PM and their closing times

turns.user_message: We're arriving late tonight around 8 PM, what restaurants are still open?
What time does the steakhouse close?
turns.agent_response:
Michael Jordan's Steak House is our premier destination for a classic cut, and they will be serving their USDA Prime steaks until 10:00 PM tonight. The aroma of their signature steaks hits you the moment you approach the Casino of the Sky, and the elegant, upscale setting makes it one of our most popular fine-dining spots.

Since it is currently just before 9:00 PM, you still have time to enjoy a meal there, though business casual attire is expected and the price range is typically around $$$$. Let me help you with that by providing the details you need to connect with our host team and check for a late seating. If you prefer a bit more time, Bobby Flay's Bar Americain in the Casino of the Earth also offers excellent grilled meats and stays open until 11:00 PM on Friday nights. 

Please keep in mind that hours and prices may vary, so confirming when you arrive is always a good idea. After a rich dinner, many of our guests head over to the Wolf Den for free live music to finish their evening. Are you celebrating a special occasion tonight, or just looking for a great meal after your trip?
